cortex.description: Unified Cortex MCP Server (187 tools total): Cognitive memory system with VFS, semantic search, code analysis, and multi-agent orchestration. Includes all original Cortex tools (180) plus integrated Axon agent orchestration tools (7): agent launch/stop/status, task orchestration, knowledge graph queries, session management. Specialized agents: developer, tester, reviewer, architect, researcher, optimizer, documenter. Config: ~/.ryht/config.toml
